name: Silhouettes side panel, hover grips and implicit terrain tools

comments.text: Dean (2026-11-26): the Add context menus are hard to navigate. Everything in them (terrain, cameras, lights) is a Silhouette, so group them all under Silhouettes, without the nesting: a Silhouettes icon pinned to the side that pops out, with categories and search. Remove the palette's pin button since the grip handles docking; show the nine-dot grip on hover, and apply that to every panel so everything can be moved. Make Select/Terrain implicit: terrain tools pop up once a terrain is selected, removing the mode buttons.

First three stories built (D-283..D-285): Silhouettes side rail and pop-out panel replace the Add menu; palette grip on hover, pin removed; terrain tools appear when a terrain is selected, mode switcher removed, Escape puts the brush down in the session. Verified in the cloud editor under Xvfb, not on a Mac. Every panel movable by its grip is next, as a stacked PR.
